title: Basic English — Course 2, Semester 2 — Pilot Variant 11

tasks.prompt: Listening 1. When will the discussion take place?
tasks.audioText: The college economics club is organising a discussion about responsible consumer choices. It will take place in the seminar room on Wednesday at one thirty. A guest speaker will explain product labels, repair services and the environmental cost of packaging. Students should read the short case study on the club page before the discussion.

tasks.prompt: Listening 2. Which preparatory material is mentioned for students?
tasks.audioText: The college economics club is organising a discussion about responsible consumer choices. It will take place in the seminar room on Wednesday at one thirty. A guest speaker will explain product labels, repair services and the environmental cost of packaging. Students should read the short case study on the club page before the discussion.
options: The short case study on the club page

tasks.prompt: When choosing a new phone, Marina compared the purchase price, repair options and expected battery life. One model was cheaper, but its battery could not be replaced easily. Another cost more and came with a longer repair guarantee. Marina chose the second model because she expected to use it for several years and wanted to avoid replacing the device too soon. Reading 1. What did Marina compare besides the purchase price?
options: Repair options and expected battery life

tasks.prompt: Why did she choose the more expensive model?
options: She expected to use it for several years and wanted easier repairs

tasks.prompt: If a product ___ for longer, fewer replacements may be needed.
Choose TWO factors that support a responsible purchase.
A product designed so that parts can be fixed or replaced has good ___.
You want to ask a shop about repairing a device. What is a suitable question?
options: I want a new one. Do not ask me anything.
Could you tell me whether the battery can be replaced?
I will open the device myself.

tasks.prompt: Put the stages of consumer choices in a logical order.
options: Choose the option that meets your requirements
Maintain or repair the item when possible
Compare quality, repair and cost information
correctOrder: Compare quality, repair and cost information
Choose the option that meets your requirements
Maintain or repair the item when possible

tasks.prompt: Write 80–100 words explaining what makes a purchase responsible. Discuss price, product lifespan and one environmental factor.
tasks.rubric: 8 points total: price and product lifespan are discussed as factors in a responsible purchase (0–2); one relevant environmental factor is explained and connected to the decision (0–2); the argument is logically organised with understandable grammar (0–2); consumer/sustainability vocabulary, spelling and punctuation are appropriate (0–2).
